mechanism.claim: In a volatile completed BTC path, an unusually early final visit to the opening level or the side opposite the terminal return means the terminal direction was established early rather than only at the endpoint. Follow that accepted direction for six hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed twelve-hour log return
mechanism.why_distinct: Price-level occupation counts all time on each side; excursion area integrates distance; opening-drive hold imposes a first-hour range; directional timing uses squared-return centroids. HVLZCTR retains only the final passage time across the opening anchor and uses no area, count, range, volume, flow, funding, OI, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed twelve-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: two daily early-last-passage clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 720 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows [D-12h,D)
features.terminal_return: log(last minute close/opening_anchor), strict nonzero; terminal_side is its sign
features.last_passage_fraction: (one plus the last zero-based opposite_or_zero index)/720; zero if no such minute; finite in [0,1]
features.last_passage_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 120, current excluded; rank<=0.30
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.eligible: source valid and both frozen rank gates pass

clock.reservation: fixed decisions do not overlap; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: last-passage topology of the completed price path combined with independently documented extreme-market trend persistence

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no anchor, passage definition, block, rank, variation gate, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.support: Lévy's second arcsine law characterizes the last zero of a Brownian path, while time-series momentum research documents directional persistence and particularly strong performance in extreme markets
external_basis.selection_use: fixed last-passage statistic and terminal direction only; block clock, causal rank, volatility gate and six-hour BTC application are untested; no incidence or outcomes
